fields.description: Program Description Objectives: this major is to cultivate professional English talents who should have better and comprehensive language application ability, intercultural communication competence, technology transfer and language service ability, who should also make use of knowledge of the major to think, innovate and participate in scientific researches. Employability: graduates mainly engage in training, translation, business affairs, administrative management, oversea sales and other works in foreign trade, communication, IT and other industries, they also take up occupations in foreign companies and well-known domestic companies (Huawei, APL, Bank of China, China Mobile and Global 500 enterprises, for examples).

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record * 2. Certificate of HSK HSK certificate of Level 4 or above. * 3. Copy of valid passport (expire date later than 30th, June 2027) * 4. Passport size Photo * 5. Official Academic transcripts(written in Chinese or English) Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 6. Highest diploma Prospective diploma recipients must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status and expected graduation date. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 7. The physical examinations Written in English and must cover all of the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered as invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. A personal statement (include study plan), written in Chinese or English (no less than 500 words) 9. Other documents (if available) 10. The record of studies or worked in China if you ever worked or studies in China * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport and senior high school diploma or above, above the age of 18 and under the age of 25, in good health; Language Proficiency Requirement: English Taught Programs: IELTS≧5.5 or TOEFL≧70 or pass the exam by CQUPT China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA): Provide transcript of China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA). Please refer to the attachment, CSCA Subjects for 2026-2027 Undergraduate Program in CQUPT , for the exam subjects and test paper languages corresponding to each major.
